title: Editor randomly shows wrong shapes and meshes when we select nodes in Scene tree in Remote tab
body:
### Tested versions

Bug found on 4.4.beta2, still happens on v4.4.beta3.official [06acfccf8], not sure if it was there before

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta3 - Windows 11 (build 22635) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7216) - AMD Ryzen 9 7900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads)

### Issue description

When we're testing the game and clicking on things in the Remote tab, the related CollisionShape3D nodes are shown in the wrong positions and sizes. In the actual game, they are in the right position, though, so it's just a visual bug that makes it harder to debug collisions.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/edd25833-f495-4ed7-b309-69a4b0999e15

### Steps to reproduce

- create a Rigidbody (or any body that has meshes and collisions)
- create some meshes and collisions (I did with Boxes and Single Convex sibling)
- play the game, switch to the Remote tab, then click on those nodes and see the highlighted collision shapes and meshes in the game window

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test_remote_collision.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18710274/test_remote_collision.zip)
